newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline prices fall.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline prices fall.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline prices fell Tuesday on weakening differentials and falling futures prices, traders said.
"There are more sellers on gas," one Group Three trader said.
Diesel basis was seen firming in the Chicago and Group Three spot markets as stronger differentials offset modestly lower heating oil futures.

Unleaded gasoline for March deliveries was bid 3.75 cents a gallon under NYMEX April unleaded in Chicago and 1.50 cents under in Group Three, pushing spot prices down 1.0 cent a gallon in both markets.
Low sulphur diesel for March deliveries was talked 5.50/5.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil in Chicago and 4.0/4.25 cents over the print in Group Three.
High sulphur diesel was steady at bids 3.0 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago and 2.25 cents over in Group Three, traders said.
